summary: Iteration 101 — 'Tautan Mutasi Bank' (bank statement line ↔ Pencairan Marketplace). Backend: 17 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter101_bank_settlement_link.py all PASS (existing link state, settlement-candidates sorting/filtering/exact_count, link-settlement guards 400/404/409, PUT/DELETE locks, full happy path create→link→lock→unmatch→delete). Frontend: verified bank-recon session detail rows (badge/unmatch/link buttons, credit row has no link button), settlement picker with disabled mismatched candidates, unmatch→relink of T1 to STL-TEST-001 with toast + Matched KPI=1, and settlement list bank-linked/unlinked badges + KPI hint. No console errors. Final state restored: T1 linked to STL-TEST-001, temp STL-BANK-* settlement deleted, 4 pre-existing settlements intact, session + 3 txns intact.

issues: Date-range filter uses native browser date inputs (mm/dd/yyyy placeholders) instead of the shadcn calendar component; the leading period input renders as '--------' which reads like broken data. Pre-existing, not part of this feature.
'mutasi 2026-08-16' link badge is 10px emerald text on white — readable but at the lower bound of legibility for an audit-critical marker.

critical_code_review_comments: NOTE (expected, verified): for STL-TEST-001 the PUT/DELETE rejection message is the JOURNAL guard ('Pencairan ini sudah punya jurnal (JE-20260815-0001)…' / 'sudah terbit jurnal…'), not the bank-link message, because _je_still_binding() is checked before the bank_txn_id guard. Both return 400. The bank-specific messages ('…TERTAUT ke mutasi bank…' on PUT, '…tertaut ke mutasi bank…' on DELETE) were verified on a fresh un-journaled settlement. Consider mentioning both locks in one message so a user who voids the JE isn't surprised by a second refusal.

POST /link-settlement writes the txn and the settlement in two separate update_one calls with no transaction; a crash between them leaves a txn matched with no settlement back-reference (unmatch would then not clear anything). Low probability, but the reverse guard in /unmatch already filters on bank_txn_id so the inconsistency would be silent.
settlement-candidates loads up to 2000 settlement docs into memory and sorts in Python; fine now (4 docs) but will need a query-side amount/date filter as data grows.
